scorecard.venue: Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association Stadium, Dharamsala

batting.name: VR Iyer
batting.dismissal: c Shubman Gill b K Rabada

batting.name: D Padikkal
batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b JO Holder

batting.name: KH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c B Sai Sudharsan b K Rabada

batting.name: Washington Sundar
batting.dismissal: c JR Hazlewood b JA Duffy

batting.name: JO Holder
batting.dismissal: c JR Hazlewood b Rasikh Salam

batting.name: R Tewatia
batting.dismissal: c RM Patidar b B Kumar

batting.name: Rashid Khan
batting.dismissal: c JM Sharma b JA Duffy

batting.name: K Rabada
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b KH Pandya

batting.name: Mohammed Siraj
batting.dismissal: c TH David b KH Pandya

balls.text: short of a length angling into the right-hander, Jitesh mis-times the slog towards long on, and Patidar sprints back for the second to take RCB to 254. They have scored 114 off the last six overs.
full toss and Patidar misses out, hitting the ball towards deep midwicket, he mis-timed it ... he will finish with 93 off 33 balls, sensational effort. 71 off his last 19 balls
slot ball, Patidar clears his front foot and swings to cleanly, slamming the ball over the straight boundary to move into the 90s

Jitesh hiocks at a short of a length ball and top edges it towards short third where it just clears Sundar, he gives chase and makes a hash to the relay throw to Rashid and they run a third to give the strike to Patidar
goes full and straight, Patidar clears his front foot and hits it to long on
full toss on the pads, Patidar sends it sailing over the backward square leg boundary with a whip of his wrists
in the slot from Siraj and Jitesh golf swings it high and far over long on, 21 runs off the over, Siraj has had a poor night
just a bit of width outside off and Jitesh slashes at the length ball, gets it away behind point for a boundary
too full to slash at that off the back foot, Jitesh gets beaten outside off
hits the blockhole this time, Patidar hits the ball to long on for a single
misses the yorker again and bowls a full ball, Patidar clears his front foot and drills the ball into the gap on the wide long on boundary
full toss outside off stump, poor ball from Siraj, was attempting the wide yorker perhaps ... Patidar slashes high and far over deep point
stumps in disarray! David cleared his front foot and tried to slam a full length ball over midwicket and missed, Prasidh was on target
banged in short and David lets it pass, too high
played to long off for a single
in the blockhole again, the batter gets an inside edge towards short fine leg where Khejroliya misfields and concedes a boundary, his night is going from good to bad to worse
short of a length outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
looks for the blockhole on leg stump, Patidar skips across his crease and plays in front of square leg
pushed off the back foot towards mid off
strays down the leg side with a length ball, David misses the glance, that's a wide
in the blockhole on off and middle, David digs it out into the covers
fuller delivery on middle and leg, driven towards long on
this is a sensational blow over extra cover off the back foot, Patidar got on his toes and slammed that length ball on the up and all the way for another six
short ball outside off stump and Patidar thumps the pull off the back foot over the cow corner boundary to bring up his half century
tries to force the ball through the off side and gets an inside edge behind square
short of a length and Krunal top edges the swat-pull off the back foot, sending the ball towards deep midwicket where Sai Sudharsan comes running in and tumbles to take the catch
massive hit over extra cover! Patidar has room to free his arms outside off and he absolutely smashes this shorter delivery
steps out and towards leg to carve the ball towards deep point
they are going after Rashid Khan now, Krunal gets down on one knee and nails the slog sweep, sending the ball into the stands beyond midwicket
short again and Patidar mis-times the pull, hitting it along the ground to long on
drops it a bit too short and Patidar slams it over the wide long-on boundary, he's looking at the toe of his bat but he still hit it well enough to clear the boundary easily
slogged to long on for a single

full toss and and Patidar launches it into the gap on the wide long on boundary, 28 runs off the over, that was a shocker from Khejroliya in his first game of the season. That is GT's most expensive over this season.
length ball angling down leg side from over the wicket, too easy for Patidar who swivels and swings over the long leg boundary
fuller ball on the stumps, Patidar launches it high over the bowler's head, Rashid sprints to his left from long on and dives but can't pull it back in time before his foot touches the boundary
played through cover point for a single, and Khejroliya has overstepped this time and concedes another free-hit, his good start is unravelling in this over ...
Sindhu misfields at deep point and concedes the boundary, Gill does not look happy. Width offered outside off and Krunal slashed hard and flat to deep point
slower ball but too wide outside off, Krunal slashes but can't connect, the free-hit will carry over ...

high full toss, that might be a no ball too, Krunal jumps back and slashes, beating the fielder at backward point. They are going to check the height of this one. Krunal has reviewed it after the umpire deemed it a legal delivery. He was off his toes as he played that and it is indeed above his waist height. Free hit coming up ...
nearly in the blockhole from over the wicket, Patidar swings it between square leg and midwicket
fuller length, slower pace, drills the ball hard to wide long off for a single
short ball, Krunal tries to hammer the pull but mis-times it past Prasidh for a single
stays back and runs the ball to the fielder at short third
fuller length around off stump, Krunal opens the face as he drives and places the ball into the gap on the deep third boundary

dropped by Rabada at deep square leg! Short of a length ball and Patidar swings across the line but mis-times it, the ball is dying on Rabada as he runs in from the boundary but he got both hands to it diving forward
short ball and Patidar takes it on with the hook, hitting it past the fielder at short fine leg and picking up a boundary

that has flown off the top edge, high behind the keeper, Buttler runs after it, Khejroliya runs after it from deep third, in the end it evades both fielders ... Patidar was aiming for the stands beyond square leg
tries to hammer the ball against the line from over the wicket but mis-times it on the leg side
finally makes contact and swats a short of a length ball in front of square leg
Khejroliya is bowling a superb over so far, beats Krunal with a pace-off delivery outside off
Khejroliya bowls a fuller length outside off, Krunal tries to blast it through the off side but gets an inside edge
slower ball on a good length outside off from Khejroliya, Krunal jumps back and tries to dab the ball behind point but misses
swings hard at a length ball and mis-times it past the bowler, mid-off mops up to his right

Krunal improvises! He moves across his crease to the off side as Prasidh delivers from around the wicket, he ends up being cramped for room as Prasidh follows him and targets the body, Krunal still manages to duck and scoop and get enough bat on it to clear the boundary behind the keeper
chips the fuller ball from around the wicket in the air over the head of the fielder at mid-off, Gill gives chase and dives full length but no stopping that on this outfield
Krunal tries to pull but gets beaten on the bottom edge by a short of a length ball that angles across him
heaves across the line at a good length ball and misses, Buttler fumbles the take and concedes a single
steps out to a short ball and carves it in the air towards deep point, Rabada runs to his right and taps the ball back into play and saves the boundary
pace off, good length on off stump, played off the back foot towards point
too full on the pads from around the wicket with fine leg in the circle, Krunal whips it off his pads to long leg to pick up his first boundary
played off the back foot towards backward point, Holder changed angle to around the wicket
stays back and opens the face to steer a short of a length ball behind point for a single
punched off the back foot towards wide mid off
stays back as Holder shortens his length outside off, runs it to deep third with an open face
length delivery outside off, Patidar swivels and pulls, dispatching the ball over the deep midwicket boundary with a clean bat swing
dropped a bit short and Patidar pulls to deep midwicket, just three runs off Rashid's second over
in the blockhole from Rashid! Played back to the bowler but Rashid mis-fields to allow the single
driven firmly but back to the bowler
tries to slog sweep but the length is full outside off and the pace is zippy and it beats Krunal
some spin for Rashid across the left-hander, defended on the back foot
nudged off the back foot through mid on
punched off the back foot towards deep cover
pace-off from Holder, angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Krunal chases after it and misses

two in three balls for Holder! Caught behind but Padikkal reviews. He should have been forward to that fuller length from Holder but ended up prodding from inside his crease as it zipped across him from over the wicket, clear spike on ultra edge and GT are fighting back
fuller length angling into middle and leg, clips it off his pads behind square

he's dragged it on to his stumps and look at Holder celebrate, he is pumped! Short of a length ball wide outside off, Kohli tried to drag it through the leg side with the pull shot and got a bottom edge back on to his stumps. Holder bowled a wobble seam delivery
Padikkal moves outside leg stump to make room and pull a length ball to deep square leg
Padikkal moves deep into his crease and flicks behind square, just six runs off that over
bowled quick at leg stump, Kohli glances through square leg
pulled to deep square leg for a single
full toss, Kohli missed out there, hitting it straight at the stumps at the bowler's end
goes back and tries to work the ball off the pads, misses and the ball goes on the off side, Kohli sprints through for the single
drops short and wide first ball, cut hard off the back foot but to the fielder at deep point
fullish length on the pads, Padikkal flicks the ball towards long leg
backs away and hits a fuller length ball through covers, had to reach for it
Padikkal backs away towards the leg side to make room and opens the face to run a length ball from his stumps to deep third
dabbed into the leg side for a single

that wasn't too far to the right of deep backward square leg but the fielder had no chance on this outfield, too small and too fast ... Kohli moved towards the leg side and pulled the short ball as it angled into him from over the wicket
short ball, gets big on Padikkal as he tries to pull, mis-times it behind square leg
played back to the bowler, that was slightly uppish
top edge and that has cleared the sight-screen over the wicketkeeper! Short ball and Kohli went for the hook, this time the ball flew off the top edge and it travelled far
cut in half by a delivery that seams in from a good length outside off, he was caught on his crease, that bounced over the stumps
short ball and Kohli swivels and pulls superbly, cracking shot and the ball reaches the boundary in a flash
plays it close on the leg side and Kohli wants a quick single, Rabada sprints across to prevent it
mis-times the swing off the pads, chips it over midwicket, and that's all he needs to do on this outfield, it screams to the boundary

played close on the off side for a risky single, Kohli has to hurry, hurry ... from cover, Sundar throws at the bowler's end and misses, and there's no one backing up so RCB get five! Kohli would have been out with the direct hit
cramped for room on the cut and bottom edges the good length ball into the ground near his feet and towards point
played off the back foot to backward point
backs away to a length ball and swats it between midwicket and mid-on, he took that from off stump, have I said that this pitch looks an absolute belter?
fuller length angling into off and middle, Kohli moves across his crease and clips in front of square leg
short of a length ball from over the wicket rises sharply into Padikkal's mid-section, he jams his bat down on it and plays towards point
played off the hips towards deep square leg
deep point has no chance to his right this time, Rabada drops short and a bit wide outside off, Padikkal goes back and cuts hard
to deep third this time, Padikkal moves back in his crease and opens the face of the bat late to beat short third to his left and deep backward point to his right
short of a length on the pads and Padikkal skips on to the back foot and flicks to the backward square leg boundary

straighter line from Rabada again and this time Kohli doesn't make proper contact, squeezing the ball through square leg ... Kohli has been standing a little towards the leg side for these last two balls
strays on to the pads this time and this is easy for Kohli, gets a bit of bat on it and the ball races to the fine leg boundary
Gill is not getting near this one! Padikkal lines up the length ball and lofts on the up, clearing mid-off by some distance for his first boundary
Siraj is interested in the lbw but that pitched outside leg stump from over the wicket and then hit the pad after Padikkal missed the whip off the pads, Siraj has shortened his length
Paddikal steps out and tries to hoick his first ball over the leg side, he misses and gets hit on the pad
strays on to the pads with a fuller ball and Kohli misses the glance, Siraj got away with that one
opens the face of the bat on the back foot to steer the ball behind point
Siraj is not having a good start, Kohli walks out to a fuller length and lofts cleanly through the line, clearing the fielder at mid-off for his first boundary

that is a superb catch from Shubman Gill running back from mid off! Venky backs away towards the leg side and slogs at a short of a length ball that seams away from him from over the wicket, the bat turns in his hand as Rabada hits it hard and the ball lobs over the in-field at mid-off, Gill covers good ground running back and judges it well
Venky ruins a great over for GT by moving towards the off side and scooping a fuller ball flat and over the fine leg boundary, that was the first time Rabada went a bit fuller in this over
bottom edges this one into the ground near his feet and scampers the single as the ball goes towards the slips
third in a row, Kohli all at sea against Rabada's bounce and seam movement, this one pitches short of a length outside off and jags back in, beating the inside edge of Kohli's punch
and again! Kohli tries to pull the short one but is beaten by the pace and bounce
serious heat on that one, short of a length outside off and that absolutely flies through to the keeper, beating Kohli's back-foot thrash by a distance, sharp bounce for Rabada
good length angling into the right-hander, Kohli pushes into the covers and sprints the single
good length on leg and middle, Venky moves towards the leg side and drops the ball close on the off for a single
that's hammered wide of mid-off for the third four in the over, the length wasn't that full, Venky stayed in his crease and flayed the drive, hitting it on the up
played off the back foot to point

it is quick indeed, he steps out of his crease to hit a fuller ball through the leg side but mis-times the shot, the bat turns in his hand and the ball goes wide of mid-on and races away to the boundary
a bit too short from over the wicket angling across the left-hander, Venky stands tall in his crease and punches through cover and finds the gap, this outfield is quick

that is some catch from Tim David to end the match and seal RCB's place in the IPL 2026 final! Siraj skied the ball extremely high in the region between mid-on and mid-off, David came racing in from long off and dived to take the catch. RCB have thumped GT by 92 runs and the fireworks light up the Dharamsala sky
goes back to a slow one and gets an inside edge past the stumps towards short fine leg
punched off the back foot into the covers
nudged off the pads behind square leg
another slower on, on off and middle stump, Prasidh defends
slower one outside off, Prasidh swung way too early and was beaten
wide outside off stump, Prasidh cuts late and beats backward point to find the boundary
full and nearly in the blockhole, dug out into the leg side
Bhuvi has the purple cap once again! Tewatia's resistance is over, he slaps a short of a length ball into the off side and ends up lobbing it to Patidar who catches it on the edge of the circle
nudged off the pads through midwicket
full ball too wide outside off
edges the short of a length ball that skids through outside off but it falls short of the keeper, Tewatia tried to cut and got a bottom edge
steps out and slaps the ball back at the bowler, Rasikh fields and throws it back at the stumps at the striker's end and hits them, Tewatia is safe though
short of a length outside off, Tewatia uses the ample width on offer to cut it over short third and backward point, this is now his highest IPL score
gets down low on the front foot and slams the length ball high and far over wide long on, full swing of the bat
presses forward and hits the length ball through point
slower short ball, bounces too high over Tewatia and he lets it go, but RCB aren't letting this wide go, they have reviewed it. It's over head height, the wide stands
played into the off side from the crease
and he swivels and swats again, but this time Shepherd runs to his right and slides to cut off the boundary at long leg
now he makes proper contact, paddling the ball around the corner to find the backward square leg boundary
Tewatia groans after he gets hit by a short of a length ball angling into him from around the wicket, he tried to pull that and missed
shot! Jumps back and cuts a short of a length ball angling across him from over the wicket through point to bring up his half-century
short ball from over the wicket, Tewatia swivels and pulls behind square leg, there's a fielder on the boundary
defended on the front foot on the leg side
nudged off the front foot to wide mid-on for a single
full and straight, driven to long on for a single
Tewatia filling his boots all right, moves towards the off side and heaves across the line at a length ball angling across him, clears the long leg boundary
full toss and Tewatia pulls to the backward square leg boundary
full on the pads, clipped through midwicket
nudged off the front foot to midwicket
defended on the front foot with bat and pad close together
length ball outside off, swung to long on off the front foot
nudged off the pads for a single
presents a full face of the bat and blocks, Siraj working on his defence
moves back and across and defends to the bowler
runs the ball to deep third for another boundary, Tewatia getting some useful time in the middle
low full toss as Hazlewood misses the yorker and Tewatia swats it clean over the deep square leg boundary
short of a length and skiddy, rushes Tewatia for time as he swivels and tries to pull
skips towards the off side and scoops a short of a length ball to the fine leg boundary
slower ball on a fuller length, middle and off line, Tewatia hits it into the covers
short of a length, hits the bat hard as Tewatia makes a bit of room by moving to the leg side
defended on the back foot on the off side
goes full from around the wicket, angling the ball into the left-hander, Tewatia pushes to long on
that's in the stands! Tewatia pulls the short ball flat and far over deep square leg
short of a length at the body, steered down to deep third
too short this time, Tewatia swivels and pulls to the deep square leg boundary
length ball from over the wicket, Tewatia lays into it and pulls to the deep midwicket boundary
strays on to the pads, glanced down to fine leg but they don't run
bowled slow on a good length, defended watchfully on the front foot
another short ball, Krunal's enjoying himself, Siraj pulls it down to the fine leg boundary
bounces Siraj now, he tries to defend on the back foot and lets it go
he tries it again and this time it works! Rabada ends up pulling the bouncer to wide long on where Kohli runs to his left and takes the catch on the run
too wide down leg side, attempted bouncer
too short and Rabada picks up another boundary, this time pulling the ball with power to the deep midwicket boundary
swings at a wide one and gets the toe of the bat to deep third
shot! Swivels on one foot to pull a short ball to the backward square leg boundary
plated off the front foot to point
caught behind! Rashid is done for the night, he tries to charge and pull a short ball but gets a top edge that flies through to Jitesh at head height
the slower ball too wide outside the off stump
a six after a lifetime, Rashid clears his front foot and launches a length ball over the deep midwicket boundary with a powerful pull shot
short of a length from over the wicket, Tewatia swats it to deep square leg
nudged off the pads through square leg for a single
backs away towards leg and drives to long off
nudged off the pads for a single through midwicket
punched to wide long off for a single
skiddy ball outside off, gets beaten on the cut off the back foot
full from around the wicket, played back to the bowler
dabbed off the back foot to point, Tewatia might be having a net
dabbed off the pads close on the leg side
played off the back foot behind point
bouncer after the resumption and Rashid gets hit on the shoulder as he tries to duck
ramped and he's been caught at deep third! Short ball outside off stump, Sundar sways back and angles his bat to try and clear the deep third boundary, Hazlewood runs to his right and takes the catch
leans into the cover drive and finds the gap in the infield
nudged off the pads on the leg side for a single
pushed off the pads towards wide long on for a single
slower ball on a length from around the wicket, hoisted over wide mid-on to the boundary
goes for the wide yorker but it is outside the tram line, Sundar lets it go, the free-hit carries over
the bouncer is too high from around the wicket, the no-ball siren goes off late ... free hit coming up
played off the pads through square leg
presses forward and squirts the ball through point for a single
clipped off the pads behind square for a single
full length from around the wicket, Tewatia clips off his pads to midwicket
short of a length and quick, slanting across Tewatia from over the wicket, he tries to cut but is late on the shot
good length on middle and off, defended on the off side
short of a length on a wicket to wicket line, defended from the crease
short of a length angling across the left-hander, punched in front of point
good length angling into the left-hander from around the wicket, played back to the bowler
slower ball outside off stump, played off the front foot towards point
short ball with pace-on, Holder mis-times the pull, it goes straight up and Hazlewood settles under the catch at wide mid-on ... GT are five down inside the powerplay
good length on off, Holder pushes into the leg side and runs, Sundar is not going anywhere, Holder is stranded mid pitch as Kohli's throw misses the stumps at the striker's end from midwicket
super slow outside off, beats Holder on the front foot push, the ball bounces several times before getting to Jitesh
caught and bowled first ball! Sindhu closes the face of his bat too early to a slower ball and pops it back towards the bowler, Rasikh dives forward and takes a low catch
this time Sindhu can't get out of the way in time as Sundar's front foot drive hits him on the leg

Hazlewood hits the stumps and celebrates exuberantly! Buttler backed away outside leg stump to try and hit through the offside, it was a skiddy legcutter and beat the bat and crashed into off stump, his counterattack is short lived and GT's challenge is fizzling out
he's in the mood all right, steps out and towards leg to a full ball and drives wide of mid-off to find the boundary again
clears his front foot towards the leg side to make room and swings through the line, hitting the ball cleanly over the long on boundary
Buttler backs away and slaps a length ball from Hazlewood back at his partner, Sindhu does well to jump and spread his legs in the nick of time as the ball zips through
keeps a bit low from a good length, Buttler stays in his crease and plays towards midwicket
goes around the wicket and angles the ball into the left-hander, pitches on a good length and squares Sindhu up, the outside edge goes between short third man and backward point
steps out and pushes to mid off for a single
Buttler plays too early and gets an outside edge that falls short of the keeper and runs down to the boundary
Buttler leans on the front foot and nails the cover drive, but Kohli is in the way at short cover
full ball angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Sindhu plays the square drive to deep point on the front foot
straight through Gill and are RCB are on their way to the final? Bhuvi pitches on a good length and homes in on middle stump, Gill presses forward and swings across the line, he misses and Bhuvi hits
Buttler tees off! He latches on to a length ball on the front foot and golf-swings over the deep midwicket boundary
strays on to the pads, Buttler glances to the fine leg boundary
good length angling into the right-hander, Buttler defends from his crease

cuts hard to the point boundary but what on earth has happened there? Sai Sudharsan has lost grip on his bat as he played that shot and the bat has hit the stumps after bouncing once on the pitch, a bizarre dismissal and Sai Sudharsan is distraught as he walks off, he had timed that superbly
too short and this sits up for Sai Sudharsan who pulls along the ground to the deep midwicket boundary, timed that perfectly
steps out a bit too early, Duffey responds with a short of a length ball angling across him with steep bounce, the batter slashes and misses
top start from Bhuvi, Gill presses forward and closes the face to play towards midwicket
played from the crease this time to mid off, pushed off the front foot
beaten on the bottom edge by a short of a length ball that skids though, Gill had stepped out and towards the leg side to hit through the off side
fullish length ball on the pads, clipped through square leg
steps out again and plays towards midwicket
strays down leg side with a fuller length delivery, Sai Sudharsan steps across and swings but can't connect
superb start from Bhuvneshwar, nips away from short of a length on a wicket to wicket line and beats the outside edge as Sai Sudharsan tries to defend
good length outside off, Gill leans forward and punches through cover, David runs to his right on the boundary to intercept

strays down legside with a fuller length delivery, Gill misses the leg glance but Duffy and Jitesh are appealing for the caught behind ... the umpire takes a while but eventually signals wide. RCB are reviewing the decision, replays show it has brushed the leg
steps out and towards the leg side to make room, Duffy follows him with a good length delivery, Gill defends back to the bowler
short of a length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Sai Sudharsan swivels to pull but gets an inside edge on to his thigh

punched through the covers where the fielder dives to take pace off the shot but not enough to prevent it from running to the boundary on this quick outfield, then Sai Sudharsan lost his balance and fell over as he completed the first run
half-volley on the pads and Sai Sudharsan drives so crisply between midwicket and mid-on, leaned over the ball with a still head and dispatched it
